findings: DOB theme mismatch on API 24–28: DatePickerDialog styled with android.R.style.Theme_DeviceDefault_Dialog_NoActionBar will inherit the system light theme on older devices, rendering a white/grey picker inside the app's dark UI. Consider switching to Theme.MaterialComponents.Dialog (MDC already in project). Confidence: possible.

Phone load trimStart() edge case: loadProfile() calls trimStart() after removePrefix() when parsing a stored phone number. Trailing whitespace in the local-number portion of a legacy stored value would survive silently. Not a regression — new values stored by validateAndSave() have no trailing space. Confidence: possible.
